description: Synthetic toll account histories for three people at the Crossway Toll Authority (a fictional state authority), generated for reproducible checks; not a benchmark task. The manifest seed is dani (fixtures/minimal.json); marisol and theo are loaded with env.load_seed and listed in fixtures/seeds/index.json. Plazas, rates, plates, people, cards and notices are fictional. No real E-ZPass or Tolls by Mail data, rates or assets are used.

sources.description: Seed dani (the manifest seed, fixtures/minimal.json). scripts/generate-seed.cjs opens Dani Reyes's account on 2025-01-06 and replays about 22 months of tolls, top-ups, auto-replenishments, notices, payments, disputes and statements through Crossway's own handlers, ending at the fixture clock (2026-11-02). Random transponder tolls and plate reads come from a fixed-seed PRNG; the current notices and vehicles are scripted. Workflow rules follow the public E-ZPass NY and Tolls by Mail sites; amounts and deadlines are Crossway's own.

Seed marisol (fixtures/seeds/marisol/seed.json), loaded with env.load_seed. Marisol Ortega's account opened 2025-02-03, replayed through Crossway's handlers to the clock 2026-03-09 09:00 Eastern. Her auto-replenish Discover expired in 01/2026, two February attempts failed and the account is suspended; her son's Malibu (BRT6618) was sold on 2026-01-20 and is still listed; a Harborline loaner (LNR4410) is on the account as a temporary plate; her sister Ana's Mastercard is on file. Notices: issued, escalated, disputed (submitted), collections, paid and dismissed.

Seed theo (fixtures/seeds/theo/seed.json), loaded with env.load_seed. Theo Lindqvist's account opened 2025-05-12, replayed to the clock 2026-06-15 09:00 Eastern. His Mazda (TLQ1185) was traded in on 2026-04-30 and is still listed, with its transponder still inside, so the next owner's reads debit his balance; auto-replenish runs on his business partner Sam's card; his own Visa expired in 03/2026; the rental plate HRB2261 appears in two non-overlapping possession intervals. Notices: issued, escalated (one after a withdrawn dispute), collections, paid and dismissed.

transformations: Authority time is US Eastern (America/New_York rules computed in src/clock.cjs); amounts in cents; IDs stable across resets.
Outgoing Mail notices and spent previews from the generated history are cleared: history counts as delivered.

Each source's parameters.sha256 is the SHA-256 of that seed file as committed; tests/seeds.test.cjs checks it. expected_counts covers the manifest seed (dani) only: records() counts tolls and notices.

review.notes: Automated checks (validateSeed, ledger reconciliation, notice-to-toll mapping, non-overlapping possession intervals, generator reproduction, date floor, SHA-256) do not replace human review of realism and variation. The human read-through of each seed is still to be done; until then review.status stays pending. README.md (Data) describes what each seed holds.
